DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemolytic Disease of the Newborn (Erythroblastosis Fetalis).

The clinical picture of a newborn with unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia, combined with maternal Rh-negative/Blood Group A status and a positive Coombs test, confirms an immune-mediated hemolytic process. The decreased G6PD activity suggests a potential dual mechanism or concurrent enzyme deficiency, but the hemolysis is primarily driven by the Rh incompatibility.
